design_description: A black-to-electric-blue design built around a dark, atmospheric gradient that intensifies toward the lower body. The upper chest features a subtle tonal abstract pattern, adding depth while keeping the overall look understated. A bold blue skeletal hand graphic becomes the central visual signature, coordinated with the crest and branding. Black sleeves keep the silhouette clean, finished with electric-blue cuffs and a matching blue collar. Overall, a dark, modern kit with a striking graphic identity and controlled use of vivid blue.
